text:
sara_ops: DeployBot started v2 rollout to eu pool-9 at 08:30 UTC and dashboard shows a rising trend of 429s for streaming lanes. Can ops hold the pool? :eyes:

deploybot: roll id=rb-1769999999 initiated -> pool-9. rollout=10%. metric: rate(429 /v2/stream)=5.1% (alert threshold 1%).

lucy_prodeng: tracing a few failures  looks like a new throttling header returned by edge that some older clients don't retry correctly; leads to 429 bursts per-tenant. sample log: `throttle: rate_limit_exceeded window=60s`

ben_sre: this could be due to a stricter per-tenant qps policy we accidentally flipped in the rollout config. Can we pause and then pin the worst-hit tenants to v1 while we investigate?

sara_ops: pausing pool-9 now: `deploybot pause rb-1769999999 --pool pool-9`

deploybot: pause applied for pool-9. remaining regions unaffected.

rachel_pm: affected tenants list from Lucy? we need to message them.

lucy_prodeng: top offenders: tenant-alpha, tenant-delta. I recommend pinning both to v1 until we hotfix the rate gating.

sara_ops: pinning: `deploybot pin-tenant tenant-alpha --api v1` and `deploybot pin-tenant tenant-delta --api v1`

deploybot: tenants tenant-alpha, tenant-delta pinned to v1 (cfg commit cfg-a1b2c3).

ben_sre: quick mitigation path: revert the per-tenant qps flag we rolled in v2 OR add a smoothing window for the new gate. Lucy, which is faster?

lucy_prodeng: reverting the gate default is fastest (runtime flag flip). I can push a canary flip in ~20m. Then we can unpin and resume.

rachel_pm: I'll draft a short customer note: "We've paused the v2 rollout in EU and pinned you to v1 while we fix a rate-limiting regression affecting long-lived streaming sessions. No action required." Include ETA once we have canary results.

ben_sre: ops checklist: monitor 429 and 5xx, tail `rate_limit_exceeded` logs, keep rollback command ready: `deploybot rollback rb-1769999999 --region eu` (two approvals).

lucy_prodeng: kicking off canary flip to revert gate on 2 nodes in pool-9. Will post canary hostnames + checksum when live.

deploybot: canary update: rb-1769999999-canary-01 -> runtime v2.0.1-revert-gate.

lucy_prodeng: canary smoke shows 429s drop to 0.2% for sampled long streams. Promoting to staged rollout once we get +10m soak.

sara_ops: monitoring metrics. If stable, we'll unpin tenants and resume at 10%.

ben_sre: if anything regresses, we revert the whole rollout. Approvals for rollback noted.

rachel_pm: release notes PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/534  adding note: "v2 temporary pause in EU due to rate-limiting regression; tenants pinned as mitigation."

docs-bot: PR created and linked.

lucy_prodeng: canary soak green after 12m. promoting revert to pool-9 staged.

sara_ops: unpinning tenants: `deploybot unpin-tenant tenant-alpha` `deploybot unpin-tenant tenant-delta`

deploybot: tenants unpinned.

sara_ops: resuming rollout to pool-9 at 10%: `deploybot resume rb-1769999999 --pool pool-9 --start 10%`

deploybot: rollout resumed.

rachel_pm: I'll send customer notes and update postmortem blurb after the release. Follow-ups: add preflight check for qps flag diffs and include tenant-level throttling metrics in canary dashboards. Assign to Lucy + Ben.

lucy_prodeng: acknowledged; will add checks and a dashboard tile for tenant throttles.

ben_sre: will add an alert that triggers if tenant 429 rate >1% for 10m during rollouts.

sara_ops: closing loop. good coordination. :clap:
